description.value: Your blaster fire hits harder while you're raging. Your blaster damage rolls gain a minimum roll threshold (see chapter 7), and when you make a ranged weapon attack using your Strength modifier, you add your rage damage to the damage roll. Starting at 9th level, whenever a target rolls a 1 on its save against your weapon's burst or rapid property, you may add your Brutal Critical dice to the damage it takes.
